notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here is a little patch to bring some changes to the bubble spell, and some minor changes.

Balance

 Bubble: The cooldown is now triggered when the bubble disappear.
 Bubble: Cooldown changed from 12 beats to 6 beats.


Features

 Online: Added a setting to enable/disable online features (leaderboard).

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Features

 Aim Assist: Added a setting to tweak the strength of the aim assist.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug that allowed score farming by killing adds at boss rooms.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug which allowed to keep perks between runs.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Aim Dash: The label is now visible in all languages.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Balance

 Bubble: Duration changed from 6 beats to 4 beats.
 Gun: Firerate changed from 0.1s to 0.08s.


Features

 Aim Dash: Added a setting to dash toward the aim direction.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed some localization bugs for some achievements in the spanish language.
